Whether you need a replacement, a spare, you want to invest in something a bit special to mark the occasion, or you're curious about what's out there, I've pulled together all the best controllers for GTA 6. I've used my expertise from reviewing the best PS5 controllers and the best Xbox Series X controllers for over six years to give you the recommendations that'll suit the game best. GTA 6 is a third-person action game, which means that pretty much any modern gamepad will work. If you're looking to get a bit more out of the experience, though, it's worthwhile checking out what's on offer at the moment. The controller market is in a really good place right now, with loads of viable options - although some of them can be pretty pricey. I've reviewed enough of them to know which ones I'd use for GTA 6 launch day, so I've tried to keep this list as succinct as possible. Below, you'll find a "best-for-most-players" recommendation on each console platform, as well as two additional choices that would suit a wider range of players. Xbox and PS5 players are going to both have unique benefits - Sony's console will have additional haptic feedback and adaptive trigger features on the first-party controllers, while Xbox gamers have a wider degree of licensed, third-party pro gamepads that don't break the bank. The best PS5 controllers for GTA 6 Best PS5 controller for most GTA 6 players Sony DualSense Wireless Controller This is such a boring answer, but you only need to look so far as the cost of PS5 controllers and the additional features this one has access to to see that, for the majority of gamers, the DualSense is all that's really needed. Still, it wouldn't hurt to have a spare so you're not constantly worrying about battery life drainage or stick drift. Pros Subtle haptic feedback Satisfying adaptive triggers Bold new design Plenty of colorways Cons Prone to stick drift Battery life is poor Other durability issues Not the comfiest grip design No back buttons You hardly need to be a controller reviewer for this recommendation, so I'm sorry my best pick for most PS5 players isn't something fancier. The truth is, GTA 6 has been developed for launch in special partnership with PlayStation, so all of the bespoke haptic feedback and adaptive trigger resistance features that you usually only see properly firing on all cylinders in Sony 's exclusive first-party games will work here. PlayStation even dropped a YouTube video to show what kind of feedback and fancy tech you can expect with a DualSense in hand. Grand Theft Auto VI - Features Trailer | PS5 Games - YouTube Watch On I do have some caveats though. I'm personally not a big fan of the DualSense since it's had major, major reliability and durability issues since it arrived in 2020. This controller is prone to catching stick drift, it's got infamously lacklustre battery life, and two of my own have seen trigger springs snap just from general use. So why is it getting a pass here? Well, the cost of officially licensed PS5 controllers is pretty horrible, so the only true "budget" option that you know will work with the console is Sony's own one. What's more, licensing limitations mean that any of those $200 PS5 controllers from other brands won't have any haptics or vibration in GTA 6 because they're not allowed to have rumble motors in them. As I say, any of the other options mean you'll be spending around $200 / £200. If that's not outside of your budget, I'd like to direct your attention to the options I've provided below. Best PS5 pro controller for GTA 6 Sony DualSense Edge The DualSense Edge is the best alternative if you want something with a bit more oomph. It's going to have access to all of the same haptics and adaptive trigger features as a regular DualSense, but its rounded grips and back paddles give it a much more premium feel. It's more comfortable to hold for longer stretches of time and will allow you to map in-game functions you press often to the back paddles, meaning you can keep your thumbs on their respective sticks. This one only comes in black or white.
